nodes.label: ADR-008 Chapter-scoped proposal exports
nodes.summary: Accepted MVP decision dated 2026-08-24: complete active chapters produce independent Word/PDF files with only relevant attachments.
nodes.rationale: A combined proposal is expensive and couples failures; users may need a chapter before finishing others.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Complete active chapter export isolation
nodes.summary: Chapters 1–3 independently export once complete, chapter 4 for reclamation and chapter 5 active subsections; downloads process only requested chapter.
nodes.rationale: One chapter failure or irrelevant attachment must not prevent other chapter exports.

nodes.label: Chapter attachment render budget
nodes.summary: Up to 10 active attachments and 15 MB per chapter, PDF/JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP; inline or appendix with proper ratio, caption and page orientation.
nodes.rationale: Merged attachments improve usability while quotas bound work and storage.
